scope: All 316 ordinary English nonfoil paper printings in Arabian Nights, Antiquities and The Dark. Earlier cached scans are reused; reserved names are disjoint within each set, not independent new scans.

order: frame, paper, mana and black levels
policy.normalization: Frozen per-set/material scan templates; no renderer pixels. Translation/scale preferred; rotation/skew admitted only with improvement on independent frame strips. Disjoint certification and warped-raster replay required. Per-scan transforms stay in comparison data.
policy.contentIsolation: All 316 outer measurements and all accepted interior rasters pass exact perturbation isolation from text/art. Source-family boundary profiles only statistically suppress reference content and cannot certify adoption.
policy.cohorts: Calibration names selected by a frozen metadata hash; all printings of a name stay together. Material templates require at least three distinct supported calibration names.
policy.sourceReview: Identical frozen opaque support for both source candidates and the current baseline. No candidate may omit weak regions. Refinement uses calibration-name medians only. Whole-line reference medians still statistically suppress artwork/lettering; this is a boundary diagnostic requiring native raster/visual review, not whole-card accuracy.
policy.typing: Original rules use exact-printing MTGJSON when available. Seven rules bodies and all 316 type lines remain unverified; do not score these as certified printing wording.
policy.adoption: 18 shared frame/source profiles are integrated on the calibration branch. Frozen scan poses are unchanged. New source-bound colors, black levels, symbols and typography are pending; this is not a completed set calibration or a release.

normalizationChecks.policy: Known shifts, scale, rotation and skew generated with the independent raster sampler; repeat after saturation/brightness perturbation. One preselected white calibration card per set. This verifies transform recovery, not accuracy on unsupported red/sparse cohorts.

reviewFlags: Antiquities/The Dark red smoothing trial was rejected by known-pose tests; its apparent 22 additional matches are not accepted. Frame-boundary normalization remains next.
The Dark lands and multicolor have sparse independent scan cohorts and retain previous sources.
Arabian Nights Mountain uses a separate colored basic-land plate and is excluded from generic land source fitting; its previous source remains.
Arabian Nights Bird Maiden (37) retains a rejected scan pose. The shared source renders it, but it does not influence calibration or validation scores.
Source boundary and independent texture diagnostics favor 18 shared replacements. Reference profile medians statistically suppress content; these are not whole-card accuracy scores.
Source-bound native component colors are partially integrated; see early-expansion-colors.json. Ten component fits remain raw, and old ink curves cannot attach to the new geometry.
All 316 historical type lines and seven rules bodies remain unverified. Title/type/mana/set symbols/rules/stats/illustrator layout still need calibration.

redTextureTrial.reason: Smoothing improved confidence but failed recovery of independently generated known poses at the existing 0.3 canonical-pixel tolerance. Confidence alone is insufficient.

geometryIntegration.policy: Calibration-only shared geometry and manual source-family choice informed by boundary and independent texture diagnostics; all supported held-out names reported. These are frame diagnostics, not whole-card accuracy. Source-bound colors and typography are next. Basic-land plates and unsupported red/sparse groups retain the prior renderer.
geometryIntegration.nativeMetricPolicy: Frozen common opaque boundary support, evaluated on complete production rasters before and after source/geometry changes. Equal calibration/validation name weight. Reference line medians suppress but cannot completely isolate artwork/text, so these are boundary diagnostics, not whole-card accuracy. No scan or renderer refitting. Colors are not calibrated yet.

colorCandidates.policy: Nonfoil references, accepted frozen scan poses, shared source/geometry per set/material, calibration names only with equal name weight. Held-out gates constrain median color, worst printing regression, clipping, shadow chroma and contrast. Rejected components retain raw source color. Colors must be replayed in the native painter before adoption.

colorIntegration.policy: Frozen reserved names reused for model selection; native regional color/texture gates, not fresh whole-card accuracy. Rejected fits and historical predictions remain recorded.
